name: Auto Tag Release
description: Automatically creates a git tag from package.json version when npm publish is run
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Auto-create git tag from package.json version on npm publish
CMD="$1"
if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'npm\s+publish'; then
  if [ -f "package.json" ]; then
    VERSION=$(grep -o '"version": *"[^"]*"' package.json | head -1 | grep -o '[0-9][^"]*')
    if [ -n "$VERSION" ]; then
      TAG="v${VERSION}"
      if git rev-parse "$TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "Tag $TAG already exists, skipping."
      else
        git tag "$TAG"
        echo "Created git tag: $TAG"
      fi
    fi
  fi
fi
exit 0
